"""
Quantum phase-transition detection for the 7-site open XXZ chain
=================================================================

Physics
-------
H = J * sum_{i=0}^{5} [ X_i X_{i+1} + Y_i Y_{i+1} + Delta * Z_i Z_{i+1} ],   J = 1

* Delta < -1 : ferromagnet (FM).  Exact ground state = fully polarised state
               (S^z_tot = +-7/2) with energy E_FM = 6*Delta.
* -1<Delta<1 : gapless XY (Luttinger-liquid) phase, ground state in the
               minimal-|S^z| sector (S^z_tot = +-1/2 for N = 7).
* Delta > 1  : Neel antiferromagnet (gapped, Ising-like), also S^z = +-1/2.

Measurement strategy (two independent signatures)
-------------------------------------------------
1. FM -> XY at Delta = -1 is a *first-order level crossing* between the
   S^z = 7/2 (polarised) sector and the S^z = 1/2 sector.  We prepare the
   lowest state of *both* sectors on the quantum device (the polarised state
   trivially, the S^z=1/2 state with a magnetisation-conserving Hamiltonian
   variational ansatz), measure their energies with X-, Y-, Z-basis shots and
   locate the zero of  dE(Delta) = E_{1/2}(Delta) - E_{7/2}(Delta).  The FM
   order parameter m_FM = |<sum_i Z_i>|/7 jumps from 1 to ~1/7 at the same point.
2. XY -> AFM at Delta = +1 is the SU(2)-symmetric Heisenberg point.  For odd N
   the ground state there has total spin S = 1/2 (Lieb-Mattis), and by the
   Wigner-Eckart theorem every rank-2 tensor operator has vanishing expectation
   value in an S = 1/2 multiplet, so  <Z_i Z_{i+1}> = <X_i X_{i+1}>  *exactly*
   at Delta = 1, for any finite N.  Hence the bond-anisotropy indicator
   D(Delta) = <ZZ>_nn - <XX>_nn changes sign exactly at Delta_c2 = 1
   (D>0 in XY where in-plane correlations dominate, D<0 in the Neel phase).
   Staggered magnetisation, C(r), S(0), S(pi) and the spin gap are measured /
   computed as well and used for phase classification and diagnostics.

Noise-aware layer
-----------------
The whole shot-based pipeline is repeated on a depolarising + readout noise
model.  Mitigation: (i) tensor-product readout-calibration inversion,
(ii) reference-state depolarisation rescaling: the same ansatz circuit with all
XX+YY angles set to zero must return the Neel product state exactly, so its
measured attenuation of 1- and 2-body Z observables calibrates the decay
factors that are then divided out of the data circuits.

All simulations use qiskit-aer with N_shots = 4096 per measurement basis.
"""

import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, transpile
from qiskit.circuit.library import XXPlusYYGate
from qiskit.quantum_info import Statevector
from qiskit_aer import AerSimulator
from qiskit_aer.noise import NoiseModel, depolarizing_error, ReadoutError

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# global settings
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
N_SITES = 7
J_COUPLING = 1.0
N_SHOTS = 4096
DELTA_VALUES = np.round(np.arange(-2.5, 2.5 + 1e-9, 0.25), 2)
N_LAYERS = 5                # HVA depth
SEED = 1234
VQE_ENERGY_TOL = 0.05       # fall back to exact-state preparation above this
SECTOR_TOL = 0.1            # statistical tolerance for the sector level crossing

_I2 = np.eye(2, dtype=complex)
_X2 = np.array([[0, 1], [1, 0]], dtype=complex)
_Y2 = np.array([[0, -1j], [1j, 0]], dtype=complex)
_Z2 = np.array([[1, 0], [0, -1]], dtype=complex)
_H2 = np.array([[1, 1], [1, -1]], dtype=complex) / np.sqrt(2.0)
_SDG2 = np.array([[1, 0], [0, -1j]], dtype=complex)


def _kron_all(mats):
    out = mats[0]
    for m in mats[1:]:
        out = np.kron(out, m)
    return out


class XXZChain:
    """Dense little-endian representation of the 7-site XXZ chain
    (qubit i <-> bit i of the basis index, matching Qiskit conventions)."""

    def __init__(self, n=N_SITES, J=J_COUPLING):
        self.n = n
        self.J = J
        self.dim = 2 ** n
        self.bonds = [(i, i + 1) for i in range(n - 1)]
        self.even_bonds = [b for b in self.bonds if b[0] % 2 == 0]
        self.odd_bonds = [b for b in self.bonds if b[0] % 2 == 1]

        self.X = [self._site(_X2, i) for i in range(n)]
        self.Y = [self._site(_Y2, i) for i in range(n)]
        self.Z = [self._site(_Z2, i) for i in range(n)]

        self.Hxy = sum(self.X[i] @ self.X[j] + self.Y[i] @ self.Y[j] for i, j in self.bonds)
        self.Hzz = sum(self.Z[i] @ self.Z[j] for i, j in self.bonds)

        # bond operators for the fast HVA simulator
        self.zz_diag = {b: np.real(np.diag(self.Z[b[0]] @ self.Z[b[1]])) for b in self.bonds}
        self.A = {b: self.X[b[0]] @ self.X[b[1]] + self.Y[b[0]] @ self.Y[b[1]] for b in self.bonds}
        self.A2 = {b: self.A[b] @ self.A[b] for b in self.bonds}

        # Z eigenvalue table and basis-change unitaries
        states = np.arange(self.dim)
        self.zvals = np.array([1.0 - 2.0 * ((states >> i) & 1) for i in range(n)]).T  # (dim, n)
        self.U_X = _kron_all([_H2] * n)
        self.U_Y = _kron_all([_H2 @ _SDG2] * n)

        # magnetisation sectors, labelled by the number of |1> (spin-down) qubits
        popcount = np.array([bin(s).count("1") for s in states])
        self.sector_indices = {k: np.where(popcount == k)[0] for k in range(n + 1)}
        self.neel_qubits = [q for q in range(n) if q % 2 == 0]           # 0,2,4,6
        self.neel_index = sum(1 << q for q in self.neel_qubits)           # = 85
        self.half_sector = len(self.neel_qubits)                          # 4 ones -> S^z = -1/2
        self.polarized_index = self.dim - 1                               # |111...1>, S^z = -7/2

    def _site(self, p, i):
        mats = [_I2] * self.n
        mats[self.n - 1 - i] = p
        return _kron_all(mats)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ ED
    def hamiltonian(self, delta):
        return self.J * (self.Hxy + delta * self.Hzz)

    def full_spectrum(self, delta):
        return np.linalg.eigvalsh(self.hamiltonian(delta))

    def sector_ground_state(self, delta, n_ones):
        idx = self.sector_indices[n_ones]
        Hs = self.hamiltonian(delta)[np.ix_(idx, idx)]
        w, v = np.linalg.eigh(Hs)
        psi = np.zeros(self.dim, dtype=complex)
        psi[idx] = v[:, 0]
        gap = w[1] - w[0] if len(w) > 1 else np.inf
        return float(w[0]), psi, float(gap)

    def polarized_state(self):
        psi = np.zeros(self.dim, dtype=complex)
        psi[self.polarized_index] = 1.0
        return psi

    # ----------------------------------------------------------- HVA (numpy)
    def _apply_xy(self, psi, bond, a):
        # exp(-i a (XX+YY)) = I + (cos2a-1)/4 A^2 - i sin(2a)/2 A   (A^3 = 4A)
        c1 = (np.cos(2 * a) - 1.0) / 4.0
        c2 = -1j * np.sin(2 * a) / 2.0
        return psi + c1 * (self.A2[bond] @ psi) + c2 * (self.A[bond] @ psi)

    def hva_state(self, params):
        """Sz-conserving Hamiltonian variational ansatz starting from the Neel state."""
        params = np.asarray(params).reshape(N_LAYERS, 4)
        psi = np.zeros(self.dim, dtype=complex)
        psi[self.neel_index] = 1.0
        for bz_e, ax_e, bz_o, ax_o in params:
            for b in self.even_bonds:
                psi = psi * np.exp(-1j * bz_e * self.zz_diag[b])
            for b in self.even_bonds:
                psi = self._apply_xy(psi, b, ax_e)
            for b in self.odd_bonds:
                psi = psi * np.exp(-1j * bz_o * self.zz_diag[b])
            for b in self.odd_bonds:
                psi = self._apply_xy(psi, b, ax_o)
        return psi

    def hva_circuit(self, params, zero_xy=False):
        """Same ansatz as a Qiskit circuit.  RZZ(phi)=exp(-i phi/2 ZZ) -> phi = 2b,
        XXPlusYYGate(theta)=exp(-i theta/4 (XX+YY)) -> theta = 4a."""
        params = np.asarray(params).reshape(N_LAYERS, 4)
        qc = QuantumCircuit(self.n)
        for q in self.neel_qubits:
            qc.x(q)
        for bz_e, ax_e, bz_o, ax_o in params:
            if zero_xy:
                ax_e, ax_o = 0.0, 0.0
            for i, j in self.even_bonds:
                qc.rzz(2.0 * bz_e, i, j)
            for i, j in self.even_bonds:
                qc.append(XXPlusYYGate(4.0 * ax_e, 0.0), [i, j])
            for i, j in self.odd_bonds:
                qc.rzz(2.0 * bz_o, i, j)
            for i, j in self.odd_bonds:
                qc.append(XXPlusYYGate(4.0 * ax_o, 0.0), [i, j])
        return qc

    def polarized_circuit(self):
        qc = QuantumCircuit(self.n)
        qc.x(range(self.n))
        return qc

    def vqe(self, delta, x0, maxiter=200):
        H = self.hamiltonian(delta)

        def cost(x):
            psi = self.hva_state(x)
            return float(np.real(np.vdot(psi, H @ psi)))

        res = minimize(cost, x0, method="L-BFGS-B", options={"maxiter": maxiter})
        return res.x, float(res.fun)

    # --------------------------------------------------------- observables
    def moments_from_probs(self, pZ, pX, pY):
        zv = self.zvals
        return {
            "sz": pZ @ zv,
            "czz": zv.T @ (pZ[:, None] * zv),
            "cxx": zv.T @ (pX[:, None] * zv),
            "cyy": zv.T @ (pY[:, None] * zv),
        }

    def exact_moments(self, psi):
        pZ = np.abs(psi) ** 2
        pX = np.abs(self.U_X @ psi) ** 2
        pY = np.abs(self.U_Y @ psi) ** 2
        return self.moments_from_probs(pZ, pX, pY)

    def derive(self, m, delta):
        n = self.n
        sz, czz, cxx, cyy = m["sz"], m["czz"], m["cxx"], m["cyy"]
        signs = (-1.0) ** np.arange(n)
        czz_nn = np.array([czz[i, j] for i, j in self.bonds])
        cxx_nn = np.array([cxx[i, j] for i, j in self.bonds])
        cyy_nn = np.array([cyy[i, j] for i, j in self.bonds])
        energy = self.J * float(np.sum(cxx_nn + cyy_nn + delta * czz_nn))
        return {
            "sz": np.asarray(sz, dtype=float),
            "m_stag": float(np.mean(signs * sz)),
            "m_FM": float(abs(np.mean(sz))),
            "C_r": np.asarray(czz[0, 1:], dtype=float),
            "S0": float(czz.sum() / n),
            "Spi": float((signs[:, None] * signs[None, :] * czz).sum() / n),
            "czz_nn": float(czz_nn.mean()),
            "cxx_nn": float(cxx_nn.mean()),
            "cyy_nn": float(cyy_nn.mean()),
            "energy": energy,
        }


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# shot-based helpers
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def measurement_circuits(prep):
    """Z-, X- and Y-basis measurement circuits of a preparation circuit."""
    n = prep.num_qubits
    out = {}
    for basis in ("Z", "X", "Y"):
        qc = prep.copy()
        if basis == "X":
            qc.h(range(n))
        elif basis == "Y":
            qc.sdg(range(n))
            qc.h(range(n))
        qc.measure_all()
        out[basis] = qc
    return out


def counts_to_probs(counts, dim):
    p = np.zeros(dim)
    for s, c in counts.items():
        p[int(s.replace(" ", ""), 2)] += c
    return p / p.sum()


def run_circuits(circuits, backend, shots, basis_gates=None, opt_level=1):
    tc = transpile(circuits, backend, basis_gates=basis_gates,
                   optimization_level=opt_level, seed_transpiler=SEED)
    result = backend.run(tc, shots=shots).result()
    return [result.get_counts(i) for i in range(len(circuits))]


def build_noise_model(p1=1e-3, p2=1e-2, p_ro=0.02):
    nm = NoiseModel()
    nm.add_all_qubit_quantum_error(depolarizing_error(p1, 1), ["sx", "x", "rz"])
    nm.add_all_qubit_quantum_error(depolarizing_error(p2, 2), ["cx"])
    nm.add_all_qubit_readout_error(ReadoutError([[1 - p_ro, p_ro], [p_ro, 1 - p_ro]]))
    return nm


def readout_mitigation_matrix(p_zero, p_one, n):
    """Tensor-product inversion of the assignment matrix (little-endian kron order)."""
    inv_list = []
    for i in range(n):
        bit = ((np.arange(2 ** n) >> i) & 1).astype(float)
        e10 = float(np.sum(p_zero * bit))         # P(1 | prepared 0)
        e01 = float(np.sum(p_one * (1 - bit)))    # P(0 | prepared 1)
        A = np.array([[1 - e10, e01], [e10, 1 - e01]])
        inv_list.append(np.linalg.inv(A))
    full = np.array([[1.0]])
    for i in reversed(range(n)):
        full = np.kron(full, inv_list[i])
    return full


def mitigate_probs(p, Minv):
    q = Minv @ p
    q = np.clip(q, 0.0, None)
    return q / q.sum() if q.sum() > 0 else p


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# analysis
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _zero_crossing_pos_to_neg(x, y, scan_from_right=False):
    idx = range(len(x) - 2, -1, -1) if scan_from_right else range(len(x) - 1)
    for i in idx:
        y0, y1 = y[i], y[i + 1]
        if (y0 >= 0 and y1 < 0) or (y0 > 0 and y1 <= 0):
            if y1 == y0:
                return 0.5 * (x[i] + x[i + 1])
            return float(x[i] - y0 * (x[i + 1] - x[i]) / (y1 - y0))
    return None


def true_phase_set(delta):
    if delta < -1 - 1e-9:
        return {"FM"}
    if delta > 1 + 1e-9:
        return {"AFM"}
    if abs(delta + 1) < 1e-9:
        return {"FM", "XY"}
    if abs(delta - 1) < 1e-9:
        return {"XY", "AFM"}
    return {"XY"}


def analyze_sweep(model, moments_half, moments_pol, deltas, sector_tol=SECTOR_TOL):
    """Turn per-Delta measured moments of both sectors into critical points,
    phase labels and per-point observables."""
    dE, D, m_fm, chosen_obs, chosen_sector, phases = [], [], [], [], [], []
    for k, d in enumerate(deltas):
        oh = model.derive(moments_half[k], d)
        op = model.derive(moments_pol[k], d)
        dE.append(oh["energy"] - op["energy"])
        # sector level crossing: the polarised state wins when its measured
        # energy is lower (within a few shot-noise sigma)
        if op["energy"] <= oh["energy"] + sector_tol:
            obs, sec = op, "polarized"
        else:
            obs, sec = oh, "half"
        Dk = obs["czz_nn"] - obs["cxx_nn"]
        D.append(Dk)
        m_fm.append(obs["m_FM"])
        chosen_obs.append(obs)
        chosen_sector.append(sec)
        if obs["m_FM"] > 0.5:
            phases.append("FM")
        elif Dk < 0:
            phases.append("AFM")
        else:
            phases.append("XY")
    dE, D, m_fm = np.array(dE), np.array(D), np.array(m_fm)

    dc1 = _zero_crossing_pos_to_neg(deltas, dE, scan_from_right=False)
    if dc1 is None:
        k = int(np.argmax(np.abs(np.diff(m_fm))))
        dc1 = 0.5 * (deltas[k] + deltas[k + 1])
    dc2 = _zero_crossing_pos_to_neg(deltas, D, scan_from_right=True)
    if dc2 is None:
        k = int(np.argmin(np.diff(D)))
        dc2 = 0.5 * (deltas[k] + deltas[k + 1])

    correct = [phases[k] in true_phase_set(d) for k, d in enumerate(deltas)]
    return {
        "delta_c1": float(dc1),
        "delta_c2": float(dc2),
        "critical_point_error": float(0.5 * (abs(dc1 + 1.0) + abs(dc2 - 1.0))),
        "phases": phases,
        "phase_classification_accuracy": float(np.mean(correct)),
        "sector_energy_difference": dE.tolist(),
        "bond_anisotropy_D": D.tolist(),
        "chosen_obs": chosen_obs,
        "chosen_sector": chosen_sector,
    }


def observable_vector(obs):
    return np.concatenate([
        obs["sz"], obs["C_r"],
        [obs["S0"] / N_SITES, obs["Spi"] / N_SITES, obs["m_stag"], obs["m_FM"],
         obs["czz_nn"], obs["cxx_nn"], obs["cyy_nn"]],
    ])


def observable_accuracy(model, analysis, exact_half, exact_pol, deltas):
    errs = []
    for k, d in enumerate(deltas):
        ref_m = exact_pol[k] if analysis["chosen_sector"][k] == "polarized" else exact_half[k]
        ref = model.derive(ref_m, d)
        errs.append(np.abs(observable_vector(analysis["chosen_obs"][k]) - observable_vector(ref)))
    mae = float(np.mean(np.concatenate(errs)))
    return float(max(0.0, 1.0 - mae)), mae


def rescale_moments(m, f1, f2):
    """Divide out depolarisation factors (1-body f1, 2-body f2)."""
    out = {"sz": np.clip(m["sz"] / f1, -1, 1)}
    for key in ("czz", "cxx", "cyy"):
        c = m[key].copy()
        off = ~np.eye(c.shape[0], dtype=bool)
        c[off] = np.clip(c[off] / f2, -1, 1)
        out[key] = c
    return out


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# main entry point
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def solve_xxz_7site_obc():
    model = XXZChain()
    deltas = DELTA_VALUES
    n_pts = len(deltas)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)
    backend = AerSimulator(seed_simulator=SEED)

    # ---------------- 1. exact reference (ED) --------------------------------
    exact_half, exact_pol, spectra, sector_gaps = [], [], [], []
    E_half_exact = np.zeros(n_pts)
    for k, d in enumerate(deltas):
        w = model.full_spectrum(d)
        spectra.append(w)
        e_h, psi_h, gap_h = model.sector_ground_state(d, model.half_sector)
        E_half_exact[k] = e_h
        sector_gaps.append(gap_h)
        exact_half.append(model.exact_moments(psi_h))
        exact_pol.append(model.exact_moments(model.polarized_state()))
    E0 = np.array([w[0] for w in spectra])
    spin_gap = np.array([w[1] - w[0] for w in spectra])

    # ---------------- 2. VQE in the S^z=1/2 sector (sweep from the AFM side) --
    vqe_params = [None] * n_pts
    vqe_energy = np.zeros(n_pts)
    x_warm = 0.05 * rng.standard_normal(4 * N_LAYERS)
    for k in range(n_pts - 1, -1, -1):
        d = deltas[k]
        x_best, e_best = model.vqe(d, x_warm)
        if e_best - E_half_exact[k] > VQE_ENERGY_TOL:
            x_try, e_try = model.vqe(d, 0.3 * rng.standard_normal(4 * N_LAYERS))
            if e_try < e_best:
                x_best, e_best = x_try, e_try
        vqe_params[k], vqe_energy[k] = x_best, e_best
        x_warm = x_best.copy()

    # ---------------- 3. state-preparation circuits --------------------------
    prep_half, used_fallback, vqe_fidelity = [], [], np.zeros(n_pts)
    for k, d in enumerate(deltas):
        psi_np = model.hva_state(vqe_params[k])
        _, psi_ex, _ = model.sector_ground_state(d, model.half_sector)
        vqe_fidelity[k] = float(abs(np.vdot(psi_ex, psi_np)) ** 2)
        qc = model.hva_circuit(vqe_params[k])
        ok = abs(np.vdot(Statevector(qc).data, psi_np)) ** 2 > 0.999
        if ok and vqe_energy[k] - E_half_exact[k] <= VQE_ENERGY_TOL:
            prep_half.append(qc)
            used_fallback.append(False)
        else:
            # fallback: sector-exact state via Qiskit state preparation
            qc = QuantumCircuit(model.n)
            qc.prepare_state(psi_ex / np.linalg.norm(psi_ex))
            prep_half.append(qc)
            used_fallback.append(True)
    prep_pol = model.polarized_circuit()

    # ---------------- 4. ideal shot-based measurement ------------------------
    all_circs, tags = [], []
    for k in range(n_pts):
        mc = measurement_circuits(prep_half[k])
        for b in ("Z", "X", "Y"):
            all_circs.append(mc[b])
            tags.append(("half", k, b))
    mc = measurement_circuits(prep_pol)
    for b in ("Z", "X", "Y"):
        all_circs.append(mc[b])
        tags.append(("pol", 0, b))
    counts = run_circuits(all_circs, backend, N_SHOTS)
    probs = {t: counts_to_probs(c, model.dim) for t, c in zip(tags, counts)}
    moments_half = [model.moments_from_probs(probs[("half", k, "Z")], probs[("half", k, "X")],
                                             probs[("half", k, "Y")]) for k in range(n_pts)]
    pol_m = model.moments_from_probs(probs[("pol", 0, "Z")], probs[("pol", 0, "X")], probs[("pol", 0, "Y")])
    moments_pol = [pol_m] * n_pts

    analysis = analyze_sweep(model, moments_half, moments_pol, deltas)
    obs_acc, obs_mae = observable_accuracy(model, analysis, exact_half, exact_pol, deltas)
    exact_analysis = analyze_sweep(model, exact_half, exact_pol, deltas, sector_tol=1e-9)

    # ---------------- 5. noisy simulation + mitigation ------------------------
    noise_model = build_noise_model()
    noisy_backend = AerSimulator(noise_model=noise_model, seed_simulator=SEED + 1)
    basis = ["rz", "sx", "x", "cx"]
    noisy_circs, noisy_tags = [], []
    for k in range(n_pts):
        mc = measurement_circuits(prep_half[k])
        for b in ("Z", "X", "Y"):
            noisy_circs.append(mc[b])
            noisy_tags.append(("half", k, b))
        if not used_fallback[k]:
            ref = model.hva_circuit(vqe_params[k], zero_xy=True)
            ref.measure_all()
            noisy_circs.append(ref)
            noisy_tags.append(("ref", k, "Z"))
    mc = measurement_circuits(prep_pol)
    for b in ("Z", "X", "Y"):
        noisy_circs.append(mc[b])
        noisy_tags.append(("pol", 0, b))
    cal0 = QuantumCircuit(model.n)
    cal0.measure_all()
    cal1 = QuantumCircuit(model.n)
    cal1.x(range(model.n))
    cal1.measure_all()
    noisy_circs += [cal0, cal1]
    noisy_tags += [("cal", 0, "0"), ("cal", 1, "1")]
    ncounts = run_circuits(noisy_circs, noisy_backend, N_SHOTS, basis_gates=basis, opt_level=0)
    nprobs = {t: counts_to_probs(c, model.dim) for t, c in zip(noisy_tags, ncounts)}

    Minv = readout_mitigation_matrix(nprobs[("cal", 0, "0")], nprobs[("cal", 1, "1")], model.n)
    mit = {t: mitigate_probs(p, Minv) for t, p in nprobs.items() if t[0] != "cal"}

    neel_sz = model.zvals[model.neel_index]
    neel_zz = np.outer(neel_sz, neel_sz)
    off = ~np.eye(model.n, dtype=bool)
    noisy_half, dep_factors = [], []
    for k in range(n_pts):
        m = model.moments_from_probs(mit[("half", k, "Z")], mit[("half", k, "X")], mit[("half", k, "Y")])
        if not used_fallback[k]:
            ref_m = model.moments_from_probs(mit[("ref", k, "Z")], mit[("ref", k, "Z")], mit[("ref", k, "Z")])
            f1 = float(np.clip(np.mean(ref_m["sz"] * neel_sz), 0.05, 1.0))
            f2 = float(np.clip(np.mean((ref_m["czz"] * neel_zz)[off]), 0.05, 1.0))
        else:
            f1, f2 = 1.0, 1.0
        dep_factors.append((f1, f2))
        noisy_half.append(rescale_moments(m, f1, f2))
    noisy_pol_m = model.moments_from_probs(mit[("pol", 0, "Z")], mit[("pol", 0, "X")], mit[("pol", 0, "Y")])
    noisy_pol = [noisy_pol_m] * n_pts

    noisy_analysis = analyze_sweep(model, noisy_half, noisy_pol, deltas)
    noisy_obs_acc, noisy_obs_mae = observable_accuracy(model, noisy_analysis, exact_half, exact_pol, deltas)
    noise_aware_performance = float(np.mean([
        noisy_analysis["phase_classification_accuracy"],
        noisy_obs_acc,
        max(0.0, 1.0 - noisy_analysis["critical_point_error"]),
    ]))

    # ---------------- 6. assemble output --------------------------------------
    chosen = analysis["chosen_obs"]
    details = {
        "deltas": deltas.tolist(),
        "n_shots": N_SHOTS,
        "ansatz": f"Sz-conserving HVA, {N_LAYERS} layers, Neel initial state",
        "vqe_energy_error": (vqe_energy - E_half_exact).tolist(),
        "vqe_fidelity": vqe_fidelity.tolist(),
        "used_exact_state_fallback": used_fallback,
        "E0_exact": E0.tolist(),
        "spin_gap_exact": spin_gap.tolist(),
        "sector_gap_Sz_half_exact": sector_gaps,
        "sector_energy_difference_measured": analysis["sector_energy_difference"],
        "bond_anisotropy_D_measured": analysis["bond_anisotropy_D"],
        "m_FM_measured": [o["m_FM"] for o in chosen],
        "m_stag_measured": [o["m_stag"] for o in chosen],
        "S0_measured": [o["S0"] for o in chosen],
        "Spi_measured": [o["Spi"] for o in chosen],
        "C_r_measured": [o["C_r"].tolist() for o in chosen],
        "phases_measured": analysis["phases"],
        "chosen_sector": analysis["chosen_sector"],
        "observable_mae": obs_mae,
        "exact_state_critical_points": [exact_analysis["delta_c1"], exact_analysis["delta_c2"]],
        "noisy": {
            "critical_points": [noisy_analysis["delta_c1"], noisy_analysis["delta_c2"]],
            "critical_point_error": noisy_analysis["critical_point_error"],
            "phase_classification_accuracy": noisy_analysis["phase_classification_accuracy"],
            "observable_accuracy": noisy_obs_acc,
            "observable_mae": noisy_obs_mae,
            "phases": noisy_analysis["phases"],
            "depolarization_factors_(f1,f2)": dep_factors,
            "noise_model": "depolarizing 1q=1e-3, 2q=1e-2, readout=2%; mitigation: readout inversion + reference-state rescaling",
        },
    }

    return {
        "estimated_critical_point": [analysis["delta_c1"], analysis["delta_c2"]],
        "critical_point_error": analysis["critical_point_error"],
        "observable_accuracy": obs_acc,
        "phase_classification_accuracy": analysis["phase_classification_accuracy"],
        "noise_aware_performance": noise_aware_performance,
        "details": details,
    }
